limits: Documented flag inventory, not per-build capability. Null means undocumented/unknown. Type hints have not been verified.

entries.name: --help
entries.description: print usage and exit

entries.name: --version
entries.description: show version and build info

entries.name: --cache-list
entries.description: show list of models in cache

entries.name: --completion-bash
entries.description: print source-able bash completion script for llama.cpp

entries.name: --threads
entries.description:
number of CPU threads to use during generation (default: -1)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_THREADS)

entries.name: --threads-batch
entries.description: number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads)

entries.name: --cpu-mask
entries.description: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range (default: "")

entries.name: --cpu-range
entries.description: range of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask

entries.name: --cpu-strict
entries.description: use strict CPU placement (default: 0)

entries.name: --prio
entries.description: set process/thread priority : low(-1), normal(0), medium(1), high(2), realtime(3) (default: 0)

entries.name: --poll
entries.description: use polling level to wait for work (0 - no polling, default: 50)

entries.name: --cpu-mask-batch
entries.description: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range-batch (default: same as --cpu-mask)

entries.name: --cpu-range-batch
entries.description: ranges of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask-batch

entries.name: --cpu-strict-batch
entries.description: use strict CPU placement (default: same as --cpu-strict)

entries.name: --prio-batch
entries.description: set process/thread priority : 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime (default: 0)

entries.name: --poll-batch
entries.description: use polling to wait for work (default: same as --poll)

entries.name: --ctx-size
entries.description:
size of the prompt context (default: 0, 0 = loaded from model)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CTX_SIZE)

entries.name: --predict
entries.description:
number of tokens to predict (default: -1, -1 = infinity)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_N_PREDICT)

entries.name: --batch-size
entries.description:
logical maximum batch size (default: 2048)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_BATCH)

entries.name: --ubatch-size
entries.description:
physical maximum batch size (default: 512)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_UBATCH)

entries.name: --keep
entries.description: number of tokens to keep from the initial prompt (default: 0, -1 = all)

entries.name: --swa-full
entries.description:
use full-size SWA cache (default: false)
[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/13194#issuecomment-2868343055)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SWA_FULL)

entries.name: --flash-attn
entries.description:
set Flash Attention use ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto')
(env: LLAMA_ARG_FLASH_ATTN)

entries.name: --perf
entries.description:
whether to enable internal libllama performance timings (default: false)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_PERF)

entries.name: --escape
entries.description: whether to process escapes sequences (\n, \r, \t, \', \", \\) (default: true)

entries.name: --rope-scaling
entries.description:
RoPE frequency scaling method, defaults to linear unless specified by the model
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_SCALING_TYPE)

entries.name: --rope-scale
entries.description:
RoPE context scaling factor, expands context by a factor of N
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_SCALE)

entries.name: --rope-freq-base
entries.description:
RoPE base frequency, used by NTK-aware scaling (default: loaded from model)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_FREQ_BASE)

entries.name: --rope-freq-scale
entries.description:
RoPE frequency scaling factor, expands context by a factor of 1/N
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_FREQ_SCALE)

entries.name: --yarn-orig-ctx
entries.description:
YaRN: original context size of model (default: 0 = model training context size)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_YARN_ORIG_CTX)

entries.name: --yarn-ext-factor
entries.description:
YaRN: extrapolation mix factor (default: -1.00, 0.0 = full interpolation)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_YARN_EXT_FACTOR)

entries.name: --yarn-attn-factor
entries.description:
YaRN: scale sqrt(t) or attention magnitude (default: -1.00)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_YARN_ATTN_FACTOR)

entries.name: --yarn-beta-slow
entries.description:
YaRN: high correction dim or alpha (default: -1.00)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_YARN_BETA_SLOW)

entries.name: --yarn-beta-fast
entries.description:
YaRN: low correction dim or beta (default: -1.00)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_YARN_BETA_FAST)

entries.name: --kv-offload
entries.description:
whether to enable KV cache offloading (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_KV_OFFLOAD)

entries.name: --repack
entries.description:
whether to enable weight repacking (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_REPACK)

entries.name: --no-host
entries.description:
bypass host buffer allowing extra buffers to be used
(env: LLAMA_ARG_NO_HOST)

entries.name: --cache-type-k
entries.description:
KV cache data type for K
allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
(default: f16)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_K)

entries.name: --cache-type-v
entries.description:
KV cache data type for V
allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
(default: f16)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_V)

entries.name: --defrag-thold
entries.description:
KV cache defragmentation threshold (DEPRECATED)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_DEFRAG_THOLD)

entries.name: --rpc
entries.description:
comma-separated list of RPC servers (host:port)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_RPC)

entries.name: --load-mode
entries.description:
model loading mode (default: auto)
- auto: mmap, unless a device does not support it
- none: no special loading mode
- mmap: memory-map model (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock)
- mlock: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing
- mmap+mlock: mmap + force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing
- dio: use DirectIO if available

(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOAD_MODE)

entries.name: --lazy-mode
entries.description:
on-demand reading of certain tensors, for example per-layer embeddings (default: auto)
- on: read the rows of such tensors from disk on demand instead of keeping them resident (requires mmap)
- auto: on, but only for tensors larger than 4 GiB
- off: always keep them resident
(env: LLAMA_ARG_LAZY_MODE)

entries.name: --numa
entries.description:
attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems
- distribute: spread execution evenly over all nodes
- isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution started on
- numactl: use the CPU map provided by numactl
if run without this previously, it is recommended to drop the system page cache before using this
see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/1437
(env: LLAMA_ARG_NUMA)

entries.name: --device
entries.description:
comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading (none = don't offload)
use --list-devices to see a list of available devices
(env: LLAMA_ARG_DEVICE)

entries.name: --list-devices
entries.description: print list of available devices and exit

entries.name: --override-tensor
entries.description:
override tensor buffer type
(env: LLAMA_ARG_OVERRIDE_TENSOR)

entries.name: --cpu-moe
entries.description:
keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CPU_MOE)

entries.name: --n-cpu-moe
entries.description:
keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU
(env: LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_MOE)

entries.name: --moe-cache-mib
entries.description:
GPU cache size in MiB for the MoE experts kept in the CPU. with multiple GPUs, it is split among them like the layers (--tensor-split) (default: 0, disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MOE_CACHE_MIB)

entries.name: --n-cpu-ffn
entries.description:
keep the dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU
(dense models; for MoE expert weights use --n-cpu-moe)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_FFN)

entries.name: --gpu-layers
entries.description:
max. number of layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all' (default: auto)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_N_GPU_LAYERS)

entries.name: --split-mode
entries.description:
how to split the model across multiple GPUs, one of:
- none: use one GPU only
- layer (default): split layers and KV across GPUs (pipelined)
- row: split weight across GPUs by rows (parallelized)
- tensor: split weights and KV across GPUs (parallelized, EXPERIMENTAL)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPLIT_MODE)

entries.name: --tensor-split
entries.description:
fraction of the model to offload to each GPU, comma-separated list of proportions, e.g. 3,1
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TENSOR_SPLIT)

entries.name: --main-gpu
entries.description:
the GPU to use for the model (with split-mode = none), or for intermediate results and KV (with split-mode = row) (default: 0)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MAIN_GPU)

entries.name: --fit
entries.description:
whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off', default: 'on')
(env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT)

entries.name: --fit-target
entries.description:
target margin per device for --fit, comma-separated list of values, single value is broadcast across all devices, default: 1024
(env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT_TARGET)

entries.name: --fit-ctx
entries.description:
minimum ctx size that can be set by --fit option, default: 4096
(env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT_CTX)

entries.name: --check-tensors
entries.description: check model tensor data for invalid values (default: false)

entries.name: --override-kv
entries.description:
advanced option to override model metadata by key. to specify multiple overrides, either use comma-separated values.
types: int, float, bool, str. example: --override-kv tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token=bool:false,tokenizer.ggml.add_eos_token=bool:false

entries.name: --op-offload
entries.description: whether to offload host tensor operations to device (default: true)

entries.name: --lora
entries.description: path to LoRA adapter (use comma-separated values to load multiple adapters)

entries.name: --lora-scaled
entries.description:
path to LoRA adapter with user defined scaling (format: FNAME:SCALE,...)
note: use comma-separated values

entries.name: --control-vector
entries.description:
add a control vector
note: use comma-separated values to add multiple control vectors

entries.name: --control-vector-scaled
entries.description:
add a control vector with user defined scaling SCALE
note: use comma-separated values (format: FNAME:SCALE,...)

entries.name: --control-vector-layer-range
entries.description: layer range to apply the control vector(s) to, start and end inclusive

entries.name: --model
entries.description:
model path to load
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MODEL)

entries.name: --model-url
entries.description:
model download url (default: unused)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MODEL_URL)

entries.name: --docker-repo
entries.description:
Docker Hub model repository. repo is optional, default to ai/. quant is optional, default to :latest.
example: gemma3
(default: unused)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_DOCKER_REPO)

entries.name: --hf-repo
entries.description:
Hugging Face model repository; quant is optional, case-insensitive, default to Q4_K_M, or falls back to the first file in the repo if Q4_K_M doesn't exist.
mmproj is also downloaded automatically if available. to disable, add --no-mmproj
example: ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q4_K_M
(default: unused)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_HF_REPO)

entries.name: --hf-file
entries.description:
Hugging Face model file. If specified, it will override the quant in --hf-repo (default: unused)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_HF_FILE)

entries.name: --hf-token
entries.description:
Hugging Face access token (default: value from HF_TOKEN environment variable)
(env: HF_TOKEN)

entries.name: --log-disable
entries.description: Log disable

entries.name: --log-file
entries.description:
Log to file
(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_FILE)

entries.name: --log-jsonl
entries.description:
Log as JSONL (one JSON object per line) to stdout, this also disables colored logging (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_JSONL)

entries.name: --log-colors
entries.description:
Set colored logging ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto')
'auto' enables colors when output is to a terminal
(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_COLORS)

entries.name: --verbose
entries.description: Set verbosity level to infinity (i.e. log all messages, useful for debugging)

entries.name: --offline
entries.description:
Offline mode: forces use of cache, prevents network access
(env: LLAMA_ARG_OFFLINE)

entries.name: --verbosity
entries.description:
Set the verbosity threshold. Messages with a higher verbosity will be ignored. Values:
 - 0: generic output
 - 1: error
 - 2: warning
 - 3: info
 - 4: trace (more info)
 - 5: debug
(default: 3)

(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_VERBOSITY)

entries.name: --log-prefix
entries.description:
Enable prefix in log messages
(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_PREFIX)

entries.name: --log-timestamps
entries.description:
Enable timestamps in log messages
(env: LLAMA_ARG_LOG_TIMESTAMPS)

entries.name: --spec-draft-type-k
entries.description:
KV cache data type for K for the draft model
allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
(default: f16)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_K)

entries.name: --spec-draft-type-v
entries.description:
KV cache data type for V for the draft model
allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
(default: f16)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_V)

entries.name: --samplers
entries.description:
samplers that will be used for generation in the order, separated by ';'
(default: penalties;dry;top_n_sigma;top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;xtc;temperature)

entries.name: --seed
entries.description: RNG seed (default: -1, use random seed for -1)

entries.name: --sampler-seq
entries.description: simplified sequence for samplers that will be used (default: edskypmxt)

entries.name: --ignore-eos
entries.description: ignore end of stream token and continue generating (implies --logit-bias EOS-inf)

entries.name: --temp
entries.description:
temperature (default: 0.80)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TEMPERATURE)

entries.name: --top-k
entries.description:
top-k sampling (default: 40, 0 = disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TOP_K)

entries.name: --top-p
entries.description:
top-p sampling (default: 0.95, 1.0 = disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TOP_P)

entries.name: --min-p
entries.description:
min-p sampling (default: 0.05, 0.0 = disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MIN_P)

entries.name: --top-nsigma
entries.description: top-n-sigma sampling (default: -1.00, -1.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --xtc-probability
entries.description: xtc probability (default: 0.00, 0.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --xtc-threshold
entries.description: xtc threshold (default: 0.10, 1.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --typical
entries.description: locally typical sampling, parameter p (default: 1.00, 1.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --repeat-last-n
entries.description: last n tokens to consider for penalize (default: 64, 0 = disabled)

entries.name: --repeat-penalty
entries.description:
penalize repeat sequence of tokens (default: 1.00, 1.0 = disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_REPEAT_PENALTY)

entries.name: --presence-penalty
entries.description:
repeat alpha presence penalty (default: 0.00, 0.0 = disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_PRESENCE_PENALTY)

entries.name: --frequency-penalty
entries.description:
repeat alpha frequency penalty (default: 0.00, 0.0 = disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_FREQUENCY_PENALTY)

entries.name: --dry-multiplier
entries.description: set DRY sampling multiplier (default: 0.00, 0.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --dry-base
entries.description: set DRY sampling base value (default: 1.75)

entries.name: --dry-allowed-length
entries.description: set allowed length for DRY sampling (default: 2)

entries.name: --dry-penalty-last-n
entries.description: set DRY penalty for the last n tokens (default: 64, 0 = disable)

entries.name: --dry-sequence-breaker
entries.description: add sequence breaker for DRY sampling, clearing out default breakers ('\n', ':', '"', '*') in the process; use "none" to not use any sequence breakers

entries.name: --adaptive-target
entries.description:
adaptive-p: select tokens near this probability (valid range 0.0 to 1.0; negative = disabled) (default: -1.00)
[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/17927)

entries.name: --adaptive-decay
entries.description:
adaptive-p: decay rate for target adaptation over time. lower values are more reactive, higher values are more stable.
(valid range 0.0 to 0.99) (default: 0.90)

entries.name: --dynatemp-range
entries.description: dynamic temperature range (default: 0.00, 0.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --dynatemp-exp
entries.description: dynamic temperature exponent (default: 1.00)

entries.name: --mirostat
entries.description:
use Mirostat sampling.
Top K, Nucleus and Locally Typical samplers are ignored if used.
(default: 0, 0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat, 2 = Mirostat 2.0)

entries.name: --mirostat-lr
entries.description: Mirostat learning rate, parameter eta (default: 0.10)

entries.name: --mirostat-ent
entries.description: Mirostat target entropy, parameter tau (default: 5.00)

entries.name: --logit-bias
entries.description:
modifies the likelihood of token appearing in the completion,
i.e. `--logit-bias 15043+1` to increase likelihood of token ' Hello',
or `--logit-bias 15043-1` to decrease likelihood of token ' Hello'

entries.name: --grammar
entries.description: BNF-like grammar to constrain generations (see samples in grammars/ dir)

entries.name: --grammar-file
entries.description: file to read grammar from

entries.name: --json-schema
entries.description: JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{"type": "object"}` for any JSON object

entries.name: --json-schema-file
entries.description: File containing a JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{"type": "object"}` for any JSON object

entries.name: --backend-sampling
entries.description:
enable backend sampling (experimental) (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_BACKEND_SAMPLING)

entries.name: --lookup-cache-static
entries.description: path to static lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (not updated by generation)

entries.name: --lookup-cache-dynamic
entries.description: path to dynamic lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (updated by generation)

entries.name: --kv-unified-per-slot
entries.description:
context limit per parallel slot (default: unset, behavior unchanged).
when set without -c/--ctx-size, the shared KV pool is sized to n_parallel*N
(env: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED_PER_SLOT)

entries.name: --ctx-checkpoints
entries.description:
max number of context checkpoints to create per slot (default: 32)[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/15293)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CTX_CHECKPOINTS)

entries.name: --checkpoint-min-step
entries.description:
minimum spacing between context checkpoints in tokens (default: 8192, 0 = no minimum)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CHECKPOINT_MIN_SPACING_NT)

entries.name: --cache-ram
entries.description:
set the maximum cache size in MiB (default: 8192, -1 - no limit, 0 - disable)[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/16391)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM)

entries.name: --kv-unified
entries.documented_default: enabled if number of slots is auto
entries.description:
use single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences (default: enabled if number of slots is auto)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED)

entries.name: --cache-idle-slots
entries.description:
save idle slots to the prompt cache on new task, and clear them when using unified KV (default: enabled, requires cache-ram)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS)

entries.name: --context-shift
entries.description:
whether to use context shift on infinite text generation (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CONTEXT_SHIFT)

entries.name: --reverse-prompt
entries.description: halt generation at PROMPT, return control in interactive mode

entries.name: --special
entries.description: special tokens output enabled (default: false)

entries.name: --warmup
entries.description: whether to perform warmup with an empty run (default: enabled)

entries.name: --spm-infill
entries.description: use Suffix/Prefix/Middle pattern for infill (instead of Prefix/Suffix/Middle) as some models prefer this. (default: disabled)

entries.name: --pooling
entries.description:
pooling type for embeddings, use model default if unspecified
(env: LLAMA_ARG_POOLING)

entries.name: --parallel
entries.description:
number of server slots (default: -1, -1 = auto)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_N_PARALLEL)

entries.name: --cont-batching
entries.description:
whether to enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching) (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CONT_BATCHING)

entries.name: --mmproj
entries.description:
path to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md
note: if -hf is used, this argument can be omitted
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ)

entries.name: --mmproj-url
entries.description:
URL to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_URL)

entries.name: --mmproj-auto
entries.description:
whether to use multimodal projector file (if available), useful when using -hf (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_AUTO)

entries.name: --mmproj-offload
entries.description:
whether to enable GPU offloading for multimodal projector (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_OFFLOAD)

entries.name: --mmproj-device
entries.description:
device to use for multimodal projector (none = don't offload, default: follows --device)
use --list-devices to see a list of available devices
(env: MTMD_BACKEND_DEVICE)

entries.name: --image-min-tokens
entries.description:
minimum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution (default: read from model)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_IMAGE_MIN_TOKENS)

entries.name: --image-max-tokens
entries.description:
maximum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution (default: read from model)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_IMAGE_MAX_TOKENS)

entries.name: --mtmd-batch-max-tokens
entries.description:
maximum number of image tokens per batch when encoding images (default: 1024)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MTMD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS)

entries.name: --video-fps
entries.description:
target video frame rate (default: 4.0)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_VIDEO_FPS)

entries.name: --video-timestamp-interval
entries.description:
interval in milliseconds between text timestamps (default: 5000)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_VIDEO_TIMESTAMP_INTERVAL)

entries.name: --video-ffmpeg-dir
entries.description:
path to the directory containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (default: search in PATH)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_VIDEO_FFMPEG_DIR)

entries.name: --alias
entries.description:
set model name aliases, comma-separated (to be used by API)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ALIAS)

entries.name: --tags
entries.description:
set model tags, comma-separated (informational, not used for routing)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TAGS)

entries.name: --embd-normalize
entries.description: normalisation for embeddings (default: 2) (-1=none, 0=max absolute int16, 1=taxicab, 2=euclidean, >2=p-norm)

entries.name: --host
entries.description:
IP addresses to listen on, comma-separated, or UNIX socket paths ending in .sock; with multiple TCP addresses, :: binds IPv6 only; overlapping addresses result in undefined behavior (default: 127.0.0.1)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_HOST)

entries.name: --port
entries.description:
port to listen (default: 9931)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_PORT)

entries.name: --reuse-port
entries.description:
allow multiple sockets to bind to the same port (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_REUSE_PORT)

entries.name: --path
entries.description:
path to serve static files from (default: )
(env: LLAMA_ARG_STATIC_PATH)

entries.name: --cors-origins
entries.description:
comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS (default: *)
if set to special value 'localhost', reflect the Origin header only if it is localhost
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CORS_ORIGINS)

entries.name: --cors-methods
entries.description:
comma-separated list of allowed methods for CORS (default: GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CORS_METHODS)

entries.name: --cors-headers
entries.description:
comma-separated list of allowed headers for CORS (default: *)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CORS_HEADERS)

entries.name: --cors-credentials
entries.description:
whether to allow credentials for CORS (default: enabled)
note: if this is enabled and --cors-origins is set to * (default), the Origin header will be echoed back, and credentials will always be allowed
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CORS_CREDENTIALS)

entries.name: --api-prefix
entries.description:
prefix path the server serves from, without the trailing slash (default: )
(env: LLAMA_ARG_API_PREFIX)

entries.name: --ui-config
entries.description:
JSON that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_UI_CONFIG)

entries.name: --ui-config-file
entries.description:
JSON file that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_UI_CONFIG_FILE)

entries.name: --ui-mcp-proxy
entries.description:
experimental: whether to enable MCP CORS proxy - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_UI_MCP_PROXY)

entries.name: --tools
entries.description:
experimental: whether to enable built-in tools for AI agents - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: no tools)
specify "all" to enable all tools
available tools: read_file, file_glob_search, grep_search, exec_shell_command, write_file, edit_file, get_info
note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TOOLS)

entries.name: --tools-runtime
entries.description:
experimental: run tools in a separate runtime environment (default: none, use host environment)
available options:
  'docker:<image>', 'podman:<image>': spin up a new container and reuse it for all invocations, clean up on server exit
  'docker-container:<id>', 'podman-container:<id>': use an existing container by ID, won't stop on server exit
  'ssh:<target>': run tools on a remote POSIX host over SSH, key-based auth and a trusted host key are required

(env: LLAMA_ARG_TOOLS_RUNTIME)

entries.name: --mcp-servers-config
entries.description:
experimental: path to JSON file with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none)
note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MCP_SERVERS_CONFIG)

entries.name: --mcp-servers-json
entries.description:
experimental: inline JSON with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none)
note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MCP_SERVERS_JSON)

entries.name: --agent
entries.description:
whether to enable CORS proxy and all built-in tools - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled)
note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default
(env: LLAMA_ARG_AGENT)

entries.name: --ui
entries.description:
whether to enable the Web UI (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_UI)

entries.name: --embedding
entries.description:
restrict to only support embedding use case; use only with dedicated embedding models (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_EMBEDDINGS)

entries.name: --rerank
entries.description:
enable reranking endpoint on server (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_RERANKING)

entries.name: --api-key
entries.description:
API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list (default: none)
(env: LLAMA_API_KEY)

entries.name: --api-key-file
entries.description:
path to file containing API keys, one per line; lines starting with a hash are treated as comments (default: none)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_API_KEY_FILE)

entries.name: --ssl-key-file
entries.description:
path to file a PEM-encoded SSL private key
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SSL_KEY_FILE)

entries.name: --ssl-cert-file
entries.description:
path to file a PEM-encoded SSL certificate
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SSL_CERT_FILE)

entries.name: --chat-template-kwargs
entries.description:
sets additional params for the json template parser, must be a valid json object string, e.g. '{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}'
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS)

entries.name: --timeout
entries.description:
server read/write timeout in seconds (default: 3600)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_TIMEOUT)

entries.name: --sse-ping-interval
entries.description:
server SSE ping interval in seconds (-1 = disabled, default: 30)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SSE_PING_INTERVAL)

entries.name: --threads-http
entries.description:
number of threads used to process HTTP requests (default: -1)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_THREADS_HTTP)

entries.name: --cache-prompt
entries.description:
whether to enable prompt caching (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_PROMPT)

entries.name: --cache-reuse
entries.description:
min chunk size to attempt reusing from the cache via KV shifting, requires prompt caching to be enabled (default: 0)
[(card)](https://ggml.ai/f0.png)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_REUSE)

entries.name: --metrics
entries.description:
enable prometheus compatible metrics endpoint (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_METRICS)

entries.name: --props
entries.description:
enable changing global properties via POST /props (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_PROPS)

entries.name: --slots
entries.description:
expose slots monitoring endpoint (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_SLOTS)

entries.name: --slot-save-path
entries.description:
path to save slot kv cache (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SLOT_SAVE_PATH)

entries.name: --media-path
entries.description: directory for loading local media files; files can be accessed via file:// URLs using relative paths (default: disabled)

entries.name: --models-dir
entries.description:
directory containing models for the router server (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_DIR)

entries.name: --models-preset
entries.description:
path to INI file containing model presets for the router server (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_PRESET)

entries.name: --models-max
entries.description:
for router server, maximum number of models to load simultaneously (default: 4, 0 = unlimited)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_MAX)

entries.name: --models-autoload
entries.description:
for router server, whether to automatically load models (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_AUTOLOAD)

entries.name: --jinja
entries.description:
whether to use jinja template engine for chat (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_JINJA)

entries.name: --reasoning-format
entries.description:
controls whether thought tags are allowed and/or extracted from the response, and in which format they're returned; one of:
- none: leaves thoughts unparsed in `message.content`
- deepseek: puts thoughts in `message.reasoning_content`
- deepseek-legacy: keeps `<think>` tags in `message.content` while also populating `message.reasoning_content`
(default: auto)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_THINK)

entries.name: --reasoning
entries.description:
Use reasoning/thinking in the chat ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto' (detect from template))
(env: LLAMA_ARG_REASONING)

entries.name: --reasoning-effort
entries.description:
reasoning effort level given to the chat template: 'default' to keep the template default,
or a level such as 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh' or 'max' (default: default)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_REASONING_EFFORT)

entries.name: --reasoning-budget
entries.description:
token budget for thinking: -1 for unrestricted, 0 for immediate end, N>0 for token budget (default: -1)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET)

entries.name: --reasoning-budget-message
entries.description:
message injected before the end-of-thinking tag when reasoning budget is exhausted (default: none)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET_MESSAGE)

entries.name: --reasoning-preserve
entries.description:
preserve reasoning trace in the full history, not just the last assistant message (default: enabled)
compatible with certain templates having 'supports_preserve_reasoning' capability
example: https://docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/thinking-mode#preserved-thinking
(env: LLAMA_ARG_REASONING_PRESERVE)

entries.name: --chat-template
entries.description:
set custom jinja chat template (default: template taken from model's metadata)
if suffix/prefix are specified, template will be disabled
only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set before this flag):
list of built-in templates:
bailing, bailing-think, bailing2, chatglm3, chatglm4, chatml, command-r, deepseek, deepseek-ocr, deepseek2, deepseek3, exaone-moe, exaone3, exaone4, falcon3, gemma, gigachat, glmedge, gpt-oss, granite, granite-4.0, granite-4.1, grok-2, hunyuan-dense, hunyuan-moe, hunyuan-vl, kimi-k2, llama2, llama2-sys, llama2-sys-bos, llama2-sys-strip, llama3, llama4, megrez, minicpm, mistral-v1, mistral-v3, mistral-v3-tekken, mistral-v7, mistral-v7-tekken, monarch, openchat, orion, pangu-embedded, phi3, phi4, rwkv-world, seed_oss, smolvlm, solar-open, vicuna, vicuna-orca, yandex, zephyr
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE)

entries.name: --chat-template-file
entries.description:
set custom jinja chat template file (default: template taken from model's metadata)
if suffix/prefix are specified, template will be disabled
only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set before this flag):
list of built-in templates:
bailing, bailing-think, bailing2, chatglm3, chatglm4, chatml, command-r, deepseek, deepseek-ocr, deepseek2, deepseek3, exaone-moe, exaone3, exaone4, falcon3, gemma, gigachat, glmedge, gpt-oss, granite, granite-4.0, granite-4.1, grok-2, hunyuan-dense, hunyuan-moe, hunyuan-vl, kimi-k2, llama2, llama2-sys, llama2-sys-bos, llama2-sys-strip, llama3, llama4, megrez, minicpm, mistral-v1, mistral-v3, mistral-v3-tekken, mistral-v7, mistral-v7-tekken, monarch, openchat, orion, pangu-embedded, phi3, phi4, rwkv-world, seed_oss, smolvlm, solar-open, vicuna, vicuna-orca, yandex, zephyr
(env: LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE)

entries.name: --skip-chat-parsing
entries.description:
force a pure content parser, even if a Jinja template is specified; model will output everything in the content section, including any reasoning and/or tool calls (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SKIP_CHAT_PARSING)

entries.name: --prefill-assistant
entries.description:
whether to prefill the assistant's response if the last message is an assistant message (default: prefill enabled)
when this flag is set, if the last message is an assistant message then it will be treated as a full message and not prefilled

(env: LLAMA_ARG_PREFILL_ASSISTANT)

entries.name: --slot-prompt-similarity
entries.description: how much the prompt of a request must match the prompt of a slot in order to use that slot (default: 0.10, 0.0 = disabled)

entries.name: --lora-init-without-apply
entries.description: load LoRA adapters without applying them (apply later via POST /lora-adapters) (default: disabled)

entries.name: --sleep-idle-seconds
entries.description: number of seconds of idleness after which the server will sleep (default: -1; -1 = disabled)

entries.name: --log-prompts-dir
entries.description: Log prompts to directory (auto-created if not present; only used for debugging, default: disabled)

entries.name: --spec-draft-hf
entries.description:
Same as --hf-repo, but for the draft model (default: unused)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_HF_REPO)

entries.name: --spec-draft-threads
entries.description: number of threads to use during generation (default: same as --threads)

entries.name: --spec-draft-threads-batch
entries.description: number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads-draft)

entries.name: --spec-draft-cpu-mask
entries.description: Draft model CPU affinity mask. Complements cpu-range-draft (default: same as --cpu-mask)

entries.name: --spec-draft-cpu-range
entries.description: Ranges of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask-draft

entries.name: --spec-draft-cpu-strict
entries.description: Use strict CPU placement for draft model (default: same as --cpu-strict)

entries.name: --spec-draft-prio
entries.description: set draft process/thread priority : 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime (default: 0)

entries.name: --spec-draft-poll
entries.description: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: same as --poll)

entries.name: --spec-draft-cpu-mask-batch
entries.description: Draft model CPU affinity mask. Complements cpu-range-draft (default: same as --cpu-mask)

entries.name: --spec-draft-cpu-strict-batch
entries.description: Use strict CPU placement for draft model (default: --cpu-strict-draft)

entries.name: --spec-draft-prio-batch
entries.description: set draft process/thread priority : 0-normal, 1-medium, 2-high, 3-realtime (default: 0)

entries.name: --spec-draft-poll-batch
entries.description: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: --poll-draft)

entries.name: --spec-draft-override-tensor
entries.description: override tensor buffer type for draft model

entries.name: --spec-draft-cpu-moe
entries.description:
keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU for the draft model
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_CPU_MOE)

entries.name: --spec-draft-n-cpu-moe
entries.description:
keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU for the draft model
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_CPU_MOE)

entries.name: --spec-draft-n-max
entries.description:
number of tokens to draft for speculative decoding (default: 3)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX)

entries.name: --spec-draft-n-min
entries.description:
minimum number of draft tokens to use for speculative decoding (default: 0)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN)

entries.name: --spec-synth-len
entries.description:
target mean synthetic acceptance length, including the target token (benchmarking only)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_SYNTH_LEN)

entries.name: --spec-synth-rates
entries.description:
comma-separated unconditional per-position synthetic acceptance probabilities (benchmarking only)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_SYNTH_RATES)

entries.name: --spec-draft-p-split
entries.description:
speculative decoding split probability (default: 0.10)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_P_SPLIT)

entries.name: --spec-draft-p-min
entries.description:
minimum speculative decoding probability (greedy) (default: 0.00)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_P_MIN)

entries.name: --spec-draft-backend-sampling
entries.description:
offload draft sampling to the backend (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_BACKEND_SAMPLING)

entries.name: --spec-draft-sampling
entries.description:
how the draft is sampled: greedy takes its argmax, probabilistic samples it and has the target verify by rejection sampling (default: greedy)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_SAMPLING)

entries.name: --spec-draft-device
entries.description:
comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading the draft model (none = don't offload, default: follows --device)
use --list-devices to see a list of available devices

entries.name: --spec-draft-ngl
entries.description:
max. number of draft model layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all' (default: auto)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_N_GPU_LAYERS_DRAFT)

entries.name: --spec-draft-model
entries.description:
draft model for speculative decoding (default: unused)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_MODEL)

entries.name: --spec-type
entries.description:
comma-separated list of types of speculative decoding to use (default: none)

(env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_TYPE)

entries.description: ngram size M for ngram-map-k speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram (default: 48)

entries.description: minimum hits for ngram-map-k speculative decoding (default: 1)

entries.name: --spec-ngram-map-k4v-size-n

entries.description: ngram size M for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram (default: 48)
